import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

patch_files.content:
import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

arguments.smoke_test_code:
row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
assert row.host == 'unreal'
worker = OperationRunWorker()
worker.host = 'unreal'
worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
worker_results = []
worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
worker.run()
assert worker_results[-1][0] is True
assert worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'] == 'backend_called'
bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
bad_results = []
bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
bad_worker.run()
assert bad_results[-1][0] is False
assert bad_results[-1][1]['error'] == 'invalid_json'
panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
assert len(panel._visible_rows) >= 1
panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
assert panel.apply_filters() == 1
template = panel.populate_args_template()
assert 'asset_path' in template
panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
panel.run_selected_operation()
panel.worker.wait(5000)
assert panel.run_button.isEnabled() is True
assert 'backend_called' in panel.result_editor.toPlainText()
panel.search_edit.setText('')
panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
assert panel.apply_filters() == 1
panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
template = panel.populate_args_template()
assert 'armature_name' in template
panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
panel.run_selected_operation()
panel.worker.wait(5000)
assert 'dcc_backend_called' in panel.result_editor.toPlainText()

import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

patch_files.content:
import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)

        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

resource_plan.policy: Use the canonical goal graph when valid; otherwise fall back to prompt heuristics. Parallelize independent read-only work, serialize local model work, execution, mutation, and validation, and keep reporting active.
handoff_order: read-only goals -> model synthesis as soon as minimum evidence exists

mutation -> validation before downstream dependent goals
all lanes -> reporting with compact structured handoffs

timeout_policy.total_work_timeout: avoid fixed total timeout for long approved work
timeout_policy.model_call_policy: bounded per-goal timeout with visible wait status and compact goal-specific prompts
timeout_policy.deterministic_call_policy: bounded per-function timeout with structured failure and retry metadata

early_completion_policy.principle: stop a goal as soon as its success condition is satisfied
early_completion_policy.handoff_unit: structured outputs matching the goal's produces contract
early_completion_policy.large_model_rule: use large models only for goals requiring hard synthesis or code generation

compiled_pipeline_policy.principle: after planning is sufficient, convert repeatable operations into deterministic callable pipeline steps
when_to_compile: required inputs and approvals are resolved
the operation may be rerun, validated, or promoted into a saved pipeline
execution can be expressed as project functions or generated wrapper functions
script_contract: rollback notes or rollback function when practical
compiled_pipeline_policy.execution_rule: run compiled steps through deterministic function calls; return to model reasoning only for diagnosis, missing context, or failed validation

function_result_loop_policy.principle: execute the next achievable goal, inspect its structured result, and check sufficiency before continuing
loop: select the next goal whose dependencies are satisfied
select its deterministic function or model engine
validate required inputs, approvals, and safety constraints
parse structured outputs, artifacts, warnings, and errors
check the result against the goal success condition
mark complete and unlock dependents, or retry/fallback/clarify
function_result_loop_policy.model_rule: models select, synthesize, and diagnose; deterministic functions perform bounded work
function_result_loop_policy.stop_rule: stop when the terminal goal succeeds, validation fails unrecoverably, or approval/context is required

fast_path: report result if objective is satisfied
loop_policy: run one deterministic callable at a time
parse result into data, artifacts, warnings, errors, and next hints
stop immediately when sufficiency checks pass

return to model reasoning only for missing context, failed validation, or no known callable
promotion_criteria: same or similar operation is likely to be repeated

visible_progress.stop_policy: Each expert stops as soon as it has enough verified evidence, emits its handoff, and the next expert consumes that handoff.

ui_requirements: show current expert and stage in the status bar

keep updating progress while context, model, tool, daemon, or validation work takes more than a few seconds

proven: Generated artifact constructs a real QWidget layout with QComboBox host filtering, QLineEdit search, QTableWidget operation selection, QPlainTextEdit JSON arguments, QPushButton execution, and progress/result output.
Generated artifact has explicit imports for the real Unreal operation catalog, DCC registry, and CommandRouter.
UI flow is decomposed as panel -> worker -> backend -> CommandRouter.
Disposable validation can import the generated module, instantiate the panel, build JSON templates, run Unreal and DCC operations through backend adapters, and report invalid JSON.
Worker contract avoids direct widget mutation and reports results through progress/finished signals.
not_yet_proven: The disposable UI uses headless stand-ins when PySide6 is unavailable, so real rendered QTableWidget visuals are not live-validated in that runtime.

import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

patch_files.content:
import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

arguments.smoke_test_code:
row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
assert row.host == 'unreal'
worker = OperationRunWorker()
worker.host = 'unreal'
worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
worker_results = []
worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
worker.run()
assert worker_results[-1][0] is True
assert worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'] == 'backend_called'
bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
bad_results = []
bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
bad_worker.run()
assert bad_results[-1][0] is False
assert bad_results[-1][1]['error'] == 'invalid_json'
panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
assert len(panel._visible_rows) >= 1
panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
assert panel.apply_filters() == 1
template = panel.populate_args_template()
assert 'asset_path' in template
panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
panel.run_selected_operation()
panel.worker.wait(5000)
assert panel.run_button.isEnabled() is True
assert 'backend_called' in panel.result_editor.toPlainText()
panel.search_edit.setText('')
panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
assert panel.apply_filters() == 1
panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
template = panel.populate_args_template()
assert 'armature_name' in template
panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
panel.run_selected_operation()
panel.worker.wait(5000)
assert 'dcc_backend_called' in panel.result_editor.toPlainText()

patch_files.content:
import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'

        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)

import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

patch_files.content:
import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

expected_files.purpose: Reusable PySide panel for browsing registered operations, editing JSON args, and non-blocking run/queue dispatch.

expected_files.path: tech_connector/app/main_window_ui.py or app tab composition module
expected_files.purpose: Add OperationRunnerPanel to the app/tab layout without duplicating existing workflow UI.
Focused tests for catalog loading, JSON template generation, and worker payload creation.

expected_imports: PySide6.QtWidgets.QWidget, QComboBox, QLineEdit, QPushButton, QPlainTextEdit, QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem

side_effects: calls CommandRouter backend or injected fake
writes formatted JSON to args editor

integration_points: Return a standalone OperationRunnerPanel that can be embedded in any host window; only register it in an app tab/menu when the prompt explicitly asks for persistent integration.
Route actual execution through existing DCC/Unreal execution services after payload preview is valid.
Keep UI responsive by disabling Run button while OperationRunWorker is active and appending progress/results via signals.
pre_patch_review: All referenced imports exist or the patch adds a guarded fallback.
The UI constructs real Qt widgets for search, host filtering, operation selection, argument editing, progress, and result display.
No UI widget is mutated directly from OperationRunWorker.run.
Run button is disabled during active worker execution and re-enabled on finished/error.
Invalid JSON and missing operation selection produce visible errors.
Tests assert catalog loading, JSON template generation, and queued payload creation.

acceptance_tests.name: loads_unreal_and_dcc_catalog_rows
asserts: dcc_operation_registry called for blender and maya

acceptance_tests.name: builds_json_template_from_selected_operation
asserts: required and optional args are present

acceptance_tests.name: unreal_operation_calls_backend_adapter
asserts: unreal_operation_payload validates selected key and params
result status is backend_called in disposable test

quality_gates.pass_condition: all changed Python files compile
new panel imports with PySide available or cleanly skipped in headless tests
method contracts are covered by focused assertions
worker never mutates QWidget instances directly
run operation builds/queues payload and reports host disconnection rather than blocking UI

proven: Generated artifact constructs a real QWidget layout with QComboBox host filtering, QLineEdit search, QTableWidget operation selection, QPlainTextEdit JSON arguments, QPushButton execution, and progress/result output.
Generated artifact has explicit imports for the real Unreal operation catalog, DCC registry, and CommandRouter.
UI flow is decomposed as panel -> worker -> backend -> CommandRouter.
Disposable validation can import the generated module, instantiate the panel, build JSON templates, run Unreal and DCC operations through backend adapters, and report invalid JSON.
Worker contract avoids direct widget mutation and reports results through progress/finished signals.
not_yet_proven: The disposable UI uses headless stand-ins when PySide6 is unavailable, so real rendered QTableWidget visuals are not live-validated in that runtime.
Host-window embedding is intentionally not performed unless the prompt asks to install the panel into a specific app shell.
Real host availability/error states need to be exercised against connected Unreal/Maya/Blender sessions before claiming direct execution confidence.
promotion_requirements: Run focused Qt tests in a PySide-capable runtime using qtbot or equivalent interaction helpers.
Run backend adapter tests against fake bridges and at least one live connected host smoke test.
Capture readback evidence: selected operation, payload, backend call, result/error text, and host status handling.

implementation_risks.risk: PySide may not be installed in headless test runtime
implementation_risks.mitigation: guard UI tests with import skip while keeping payload/service tests deterministic

arguments.smoke_test_code:
row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
assert row.host == 'unreal'
worker = OperationRunWorker()
worker.host = 'unreal'
worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
worker_results = []
worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
worker.run()
assert worker_results[-1][0] is True
assert worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'] == 'backend_called'
bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
bad_results = []
bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
bad_worker.run()
assert bad_results[-1][0] is False
assert bad_results[-1][1]['error'] == 'invalid_json'
panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
assert len(panel._visible_rows) >= 1
panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
assert panel.apply_filters() == 1
template = panel.populate_args_template()
assert 'asset_path' in template
panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
panel.run_selected_operation()
panel.worker.wait(5000)
assert panel.run_button.isEnabled() is True
assert 'backend_called' in panel.result_editor.toPlainText()
panel.search_edit.setText('')
panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
assert panel.apply_filters() == 1
panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
template = panel.populate_args_template()
assert 'armature_name' in template
panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
panel.run_selected_operation()
panel.worker.wait(5000)
assert 'dcc_backend_called' in panel.result_editor.toPlainText()

import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())

patch_files.content:
import os
import unittest

os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from tech_connector.ui.operation_runner_panel import OperationRow, OperationRunWorker, OperationRunnerPanel, operation_catalog

class TestOperationRunnerPanel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])

    def test_worker_builds_unreal_payload_and_reports_invalid_json(self):
        row = OperationRow.from_unreal(operation_catalog()[0])
        self.assertEqual(row.host, 'unreal')
        worker = OperationRunWorker()
        worker.host = 'unreal'
        worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        worker.args_json = '{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}'
        worker_results = []
        worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: worker_results.append((ok, payload)))
        worker.run()
        self.assertTrue(worker_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(worker_results[-1][1]['result']['status'], 'backend_called')
        bad_worker = OperationRunWorker()
        bad_worker.host = 'unreal'
        bad_worker.operation_key = 'blueprint.scan'
        bad_worker.args_json = '{bad json}'
        bad_results = []
        bad_worker.finished.connect(lambda ok, payload: bad_results.append((ok, payload)))
        bad_worker.run()
        self.assertFalse(bad_results[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(bad_results[-1][1]['error'], 'invalid_json')

    def test_panel_refresh_template_run_and_result_output(self):
        panel = OperationRunnerPanel()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(panel._visible_rows), 1)
        panel.search_edit.setText('blueprint')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('asset_path', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"asset_path": "/Game/Test/BP_Test"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertTrue(panel.run_button.isEnabled())
        self.assertIn('backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
        panel.search_edit.setText('')
        panel.host_filter.setCurrentText('blender')
        self.assertEqual(panel.apply_filters(), 1)
        panel.operation_table.selectRow(0)
        template = panel.populate_args_template()
        self.assertIn('armature_name', template)
        panel.args_editor.setPlainText('{"armature_name": "MannyRig"}')
        panel.run_selected_operation()
        panel.worker.wait(5000)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        self.assertIn('dcc_backend_called', panel.result_editor.toPlainText())
